newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil shares end modestly up after U.S. rate rise.
newsitem.headline: Brazil shares end modestly up after U.S. rate rise.

text.p: Brazilian shares eased on Tuesday after jumping over one percent earlier as the U.S. Federal Reserve confirmed market expectations of a 25 basis point increase in U.S. short term rates, brokers said.
The Bovespa index of the 49 most liquid stocks closed up 0.56 percent at 9,380 points. Volume was a high 604.3 million reais ($570.09 million).
Bellwether Telebras preferred closed at 113.99 reais, up 0.26 percent, while its common stock traded at 111 reais, up 0.54 percent.
State mining concern Companhia Vale do Rio Doce (CVRD)
Oil firm Petrobras preferred gained 2.3 percent to 222 reais.
The Sao Paulo bourse's power sector index, comprising the nine most liquid stocks of the electrical sector, ended up 0.66 percent at 2,543 points.
